propositions: Strict eval-spec validation (validate_eval_spec with strict=True) currently runs only in the non-gating Prompt Eval workflow, not in the default pytest suite that gates the Verified vote.
Dataset-bearing eval specs can ship without gold_set and still merge Verified +1, as three plan-review specs (asserted-capability, decomp-shape, necessity) demonstrated before the defect was caught.
No unit test globs and validates all packaged eval specs; the existing test_new_eval_specs.py only checks a hardcoded 3-spec tuple, missing new specs.
Moving strict validation into tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py (collected by the default suite) will gate it via gerrit-verify.yaml's build-and-test job and block Verified pre-merge.
The redundant inline validation step in prompt-eval.yml can be removed once the glob-based unit test is in place and passing.
